{{Term/Store|Satty||Series, BotW}} is a character in {{BotW}}.<ref name="Satty"/>

==Biography==
[[Satty]] is a [[Hylian Retriever]] who can be found at [[Wetland Stable]] with his owner, [[Quince]]. The only reason Quince stays at the [[Stable]] is for Satty's sake,<ref>{{Cite|Satty's the only reason I'm sticking around this dump.|Quince|BotW}}</ref> since by leaving, he would either abandon Satty or put him in danger.<ref>{{Cite|But I don't want to abandon Satty or put him in danger, so I'm in a bit of a tight spot.|Quince|BotW}}</ref>

Quince originally found Satty on [[Satori Mountain]] when he was a puppy.<ref>{{Cite|So I go to the mountain and wait for the animals to show up. When suddenly this dirty little pup appears out of nowhere!|Quince|BotW}}</ref> Since Satty was one his own,<ref>{{Cite|I figure he's been separated from his parents or abandoned by his last owner.|Quince|BotW}}</ref> Quince decided to give him some of his food.<ref>{{Cite|He starts begging for food, so I give him some jerky, and he runs off over a hill...|Quince|BotW}}</ref>

At one point, Quince fell asleep and woke up to a [[Lord of the Mountain|glowing beast]] standing in front of him.<ref>{{Cite|Later on, I doze off for a little while, and when I come to, there's a big {{Color BotW|Blue|glowing beast}} standing right in front of me!|Quince|BotW}}</ref> He was unable to react, and the beast charged at him.<ref>{{Cite|It caught me completely off guard. I couldn't even draw my bow! I just stared at it! And then the {{Color BotW|Blue|beast}} runs at me like it wants to trample me!|Quince|BotW}}</ref> Suddenly, Satty jumped in between them and started barking at the beast, despite his own fear.<ref>{{Cite|Suddenly the pup I gave food to jumps in between us! He starts barking at the {{Color BotW|Blue|beast}}, was was ten times his size! All to...protect me... Even though he was trembling with fear...|Quince|BotW}}</ref> When the beast recoiled, Quince grabbed Satty and fled from the Mountain.<ref>{{Cite|Then the {{Color BotW|Blue|beast}} recoiled a bit... So I took the chance to snatch up the pup and flee down the mountain, tripping and falling all the way...|Quince|BotW}}</ref> Ever since, the two of them have been best friends.<ref name="Buds"/>

Like other Hylian Retrievers, Satty can lead [[Link]] to a buried [[Treasure Chest]] if he's fed enough times. The chest contains an [[Opal]].
